registry_entry.description: SDD 10 research package: literature search, paper retrieval, metadata resolution, citation verification, and repository search, over two interchangeable MCP connector backends. Declares no code execution capability (ADR3-M5-002).

capabilities.description: Search external literature and return normalized evidence candidates.
Retrieve one paper by identifier as a normalized evidence candidate.
Resolve an identifier to the metadata record the register holds for it.
Resolve a cited work and report the identifier actually registered for it.
Search source repositories associated with published work.

manifest.description: SDD 10 research package: literature search, paper retrieval, metadata resolution, citation verification, and repository search, over two interchangeable MCP connector backends. Declares no code execution capability (ADR3-M5-002).
manifest.name: Accretion Research Intelligence

skills.description: Gather literature for a question and keep every candidate's provenance.
skills.instructions: Call research.literature.search with the operator's question. Every returned candidate already carries its connector, capability, query, timestamp and source identifier; never restate or edit those fields.

skills.description: Retrieve the full record behind a candidate found by search.
skills.instructions: Call research.paper.fetch with the source identifier a prior research.literature.search returned. Do not guess identifiers.

skills.description: Resolve an identifier to the metadata the register actually holds.
skills.instructions: Call research.metadata.resolve. Resolution reports where an identifier points; it is not a claim that the citation is correct.

skills.description: Check a claimed citation against the identifier the register returns.
skills.instructions: Call research.citation.verify with the paper identifier and the claimed citation. Treat a disagreement as a finding, not as an error to retry.

skills.description: Survey source repositories alongside the literature for a question.
skills.instructions: Call github.search for implementations, then research.literature.search for the work they cite. This package performs no code execution.
